name: Olive & Oak
description: A warm, material-rich interior for a private residence in Gandhinagar. Olive & Oak takes its name from the two defining elements of the space — sage green accents and solid oak joinery that run consistently through the bedrooms. Blue Door Architects designed and executed the full turnkey interior, including custom wardrobes with fluted detail and lit display shelving, upholstered furniture, and curated artwork — delivering the completed home ahead of the client's personal deadline.
